name: ev-study-watch-reader
description: Read-only: lets E.V. Home read your latest school note and E.V.'s context file from Documents/E.V. Study Watch.
long_description: E.V. Home, opened in the Claude desktop app, uses this to read two files in Documents/E.V. Study Watch: context.json (written by E.V.'s evening run) and live/latest.json (your latest NUR 112 or BIO 201 note, written by Study Watch in reader mode). It cannot write, delete or list files, reads nothing else, skips notes tagged #graded, and never returns Journal, personal or E.V. folders.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether the folder is reachable, when context.json was written, and which note Study Watch saved last (no note text).

tools.name: latest_note
tools.description: Your latest NUR 112 or BIO 201 note's plain text, or unchanged:true when nothing new was written.
